ui_bugs.issue: Navigating directly to /jobs/:id/edit for a job whose status is in_progress/completed/cancelled renders the EMPTY 'Edit job' form (page title 'Edit job', placeholders only, no pre-fill, no edit_job_not_open warning, no redirect). The PATCH would 400 on submit, but the user shouldn't reach this state. JobDetailPage already hides edit-job-btn for non-open jobs (correct), but the route itself is unguarded.

action_items: MEDIUM: PostJobPage in edit mode should guard against non-open job status. When the GET /api/jobs/:id returns status != 'open', either: (a) redirect to /jobs/:id with a toast using translation key 'edit_job_not_open', or (b) render a disabled/error card instead of the empty form. Currently the route is reachable via direct URL even though the JobDetailPage button correctly hides it.

OPTIONAL: PATCH /api/jobs/:id returns 422 (pydantic) for title min_length<5, but test in spec said '400 on title<5'. Spec wording is broad; 422 is conventional FastAPI/pydantic. Worth aligning if the spec is strict.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/job_routes.py update_job: budget guard correctly handles partial updates by merging incoming with stored. attachments validated at len(>5) (good). edited_at always set with UTC tz — good.

/app/backend/routes/pro_routes.py enrichment: try/except around ObjectId(job_id) properly swallows malformed job ids, so a review with corrupt job_id won't 500 the endpoint. job_completed_at uses ISO; null when not completed.
PostJobPage frontend (edit mode): missing status guard. Should check job.status==='open' after loading the job and bail out otherwise.
